title: BC Friday Tips #42 User Setup Management
summary: The User Setup Management codeunit provides built-in functions for checking posting dates and retrieving sales/purchase filters, helping developers avoid reinventing common logic and maintain consistency across applications.
key_points: User Setup Management codeunit includes functions like CheckAllowedPostingDate, CheckAllowedPostingDatesRange, and TestAllowedPostingDate for date validation
The codeunit provides GetSalesInvoicePostingPolicy and GetPurchaseInvoicePostingPolicy functions for posting policy management
GetSalesFilter and GetPurchasesFilter functions are available for retrieving user-specific filters
Using this codeunit saves development time and maintains consistent logic across the application

quotes.text: Save development time. Keeps the logic consistent.
quotes.why_it_matters: Explains the primary benefits of using this codeunit instead of writing custom logic

quotes.text: No need to reinvent the wheel.
quotes.why_it_matters: Emphasizes that developers should leverage existing functionality rather than duplicating effort
